Task: Batch Speech-to-Text

Write Python code that requests speaker diarization for a recorded meeting using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
import os
import time
import requests

ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY = os.environ["ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY"]
ASSEMBLYAI_BASE_URL = "https://api.assemblyai.com/v2"

def transcribe_meeting_with_diarization(audio_url: str, *, speaker_labels: bool = True, speakers_expected: int | None = None) -> dict:
    headers = {
        "authorization": ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY,
        "content-type": "application/json",
    }

    payload = {
        "audio_url": audio_url,
        "speaker_labels": speaker_labels,
    }
    if speakers_expected is not None:
        payload["speakers_expected"] = speakers_expected

    create_resp = requests.post(
        f"{ASSEMBLYAI_BASE_URL}/transcript",
        headers=headers,
        json=payload,
        timeout=30,
    )
    create_resp.raise_for_status()
    transcript = create_resp.json()
    transcript_id = transcript["id"]

    while True:
        poll_resp = requests.get(
            f"{ASSEMBLYAI_BASE_URL}/transcript/{transcript_id}",
            headers={"authorization": ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY},
            timeout=30,
        )
        poll_resp.raise_for_status()
        result = poll_resp.json()
        status = result["status"]

        if status == "completed":
            utterances = []
            for utt in result.get("utterances", []):
                utterances.append({
                    "speaker": utt.get("speaker"),
                    "start_ms": utt.get("start"),
                    "end_ms": utt.get("end"),
                    "text": utt.get("text"),
                    "confidence": utt.get("confidence"),
                })

            return {
                "id": result["id"],
                "status": status,
                "text": result.get("text", ""),
                "utterances": utterances,
                "audio_duration_seconds": result.get("audio_duration"),
            }

        if status == "error":
            raise RuntimeError(result.get("error", "AssemblyAI transcription failed"))

        time.sleep(3)
